type.description: Controls the visual layout of the user menu.

size.description: Controls the overall size of the user menu.

userInitials.description: Initials for the primary user profile. Available when type!=signIn.

userLabel.description: Label for the primary user profile. Available when type!=signIn.

userRole.description: Role shown under the primary user's label; omit it to show no role. Available when type!=signIn && size==regular.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
